params.tokenA: First token of the pair (any order – function sorts them).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

params.liquidity: Amount of liquidity tokens to burn.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.to: Address to receive the output token.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

getPair(address,address).notice: Returns the pair address for a given token pair (sorted).

removeLiquidity(address,address,uint256).notice: Remove liquidity and receive the underlying tokens.

setFeeBP(uint256).notice: Change the trading fee (basis points). Only owner can call.

setFeeCollector(address).notice: Set the fee collector address (where swap fees are sent).

swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnT.notice: Same as above but also supports tokens that charge a fee on transfer         (e.g., USDT). The function pulls the required amount + fee from the         caller, then performs the swap.
